parent=json.loads(parent_path.read_text());full=json.loads(raw_path.read_text())

assert len(full["cells"])==4 and all(c["status"]=="independent_content_readback_verified" for c in full["cells"])
compact_path=base/"copy_branch_qfo_terminal_readback_compact_v1_20261013.json";assert not compact_path.exists()
slim=[]
for c in full["cells"]:
    small={k:v for k,v in c.items() if k!="checked"}
    small["checked_records_storage"]={"full_local_readback":record(raw_path),"method_key":c["method_key"],"records":len(c.get("checked",[]))}
    slim.append(small)
write_json(compact_path,{"status":"all_terminal_qfo_branch_cells_independently_admitted","full_local_readback":record(raw_path),"scheduler":full["scheduler"],"cells":slim,"captures":full["captures"],"executed_sources":full["executed_sources"],"scope":"Full local content audits retained by hash; compact receipt omits only large repeated checked-record lists.","defaults_promoted":False,"goal_completed":False})
methods=parent["methods"];unchanged={m["key"]:json.dumps(m,sort_keys=True) for m in methods if not m["key"].startswith("copy_branch:")}
for c in slim:
    m=next(m for m in methods if m["key"]==c["method_key"])
    positions=[i for i,x in enumerate(m["cells"]) if x["dataset"]=="QfO"];assert len(positions)==1
    previous=m["cells"][positions[0]]
    if previous["status"]=="independent_content_readback_verified":
        assert previous["scores"]==c["scores"] and previous["products"]==c["products"]
    m["cells"][positions[0]]=c;m["scores"].update(c["scores"]);m["complete_eight_endpoints"]=set(m["scores"])==set(ENDPOINTS)
for m in methods:
    if m["key"] in unchanged: assert json.dumps(m,sort_keys=True)==unchanged[m["key"]]
vectors={m["key"].split(":",1)[1]:m["scores"] for m in methods if m["key"].startswith("copy_branch:")}
screening=dict(parent["round_screening"]);screening["copy_branch"]=screen(vectors,"control")
assert all(c["complete_eight_endpoint_contrast"] for c in screening["copy_branch"]["comparisons"].values())
assert not any(c["passes_point_estimate_screen"] for c in screening["copy_branch"]["comparisons"].values())
out=base/"hillclimb_comparison_readback_v8_20261013";assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
with (out/"scores.tsv").open("x",newline="") as f:
    w=csv.writer(f,delimiter="\t",lineterminator="\n");w.writerow(["method",*ENDPOINTS,"complete_eight_endpoints"])
    for m in methods: w.writerow([m["label"],*(m["scores"].get(k,"NA") for k in ENDPOINTS),set(m["scores"])==set(ENDPOINTS)])
with (out/"scores.tsv").open() as f: rows=list(csv.DictReader(f,delimiter="\t"))
assert len(rows)==len(methods)==22
for row,m in zip(rows,methods):
    for k in ENDPOINTS: assert row[k]=="NA" if k not in m["scores"] else float(row[k])==m["scores"][k]

decision=base/"hillclimb_terminal_copy_branch_decision_20261013.json";assert not decision.exists()
write_json(decision,{"status":"all_own_tree_copy_branch_vectors_complete_no_default_promotion","comparison":record(out/"summary.json"),"terminal_readback":record(compact_path),"screen":screening["copy_branch"],"rejected_variants":{label:{k:v for k,v in c["deltas_from_matched_control"].items() if v<-.005} for label,c in screening["copy_branch"]["comparisons"].items() if label!="control"},"next_action":"Evaluate the prespecified bounded strong-component retention profile with matched HMM graphs and candidate-specific inferred trees.
